Name: Farmhouse Visits
Author: mistyspring
Description:
[size=4][u][b][img]https://64.media.tumblr.com/785d35b3be0f896a00a15d75dda8cdd7/ce5c30fe86a2d83a-f2/s500x750/1beb627f765f66b71244722a60c626be42124c99.png[/img][/b][/u][/size]

[size=3]English:[/size][/b][/u][size=3]
This mod allows villagers to visit when you're in the farmhouse, in a similar fashion to a certain animal game.

[/size][size=3][b][u][size=3][u][b]Español[/b][/u][/size]:[/u][/b]
Este mod permite que los NPC te visiten cuando estás en tu casa, similar a un cierto juego de animales.

[b][u]The mod is avaiable in spanish, english, and:[/u][/b]
[/size][list]
[*][size=3]Turkish (by BURAKMESE)[/size]
[*][size=3]Chinese (by SHIZHI01420142)[/size]
[*][size=3]Russian (by [/size][size=3]crybaby00000[/size])
[*][size=3]Portuguese (by BrasileiroTop)[/size]
[*][size=3]Thai (by watchakorn-18k)
[/size]
[/list]
[img]https://64.media.tumblr.com/374a97664edd56f783a6a2813aba0038/ce5c30fe86a2d83a-59/s400x600/01a21347740cdc17d2f3372a28b43bbdf4278485.png[/img]

[u][b][size=3]English:[/size][/b][/u][list]
[*][size=3]Compatible with mod farmhouses / mod npcs[/size]
[*][size=3]More hearts = more likely to visit[/size]
[*][size=3]Blacklist option[/size]
[*][size=3]Custom start/end hours[/size]
[*][size=3][size=3]Custom[/size] chance (for every 10 minutes)[/size]
[*][size=3]Works on multiplayer[/size]
[*][size=3](Optional) visits bring gifts[/size]
[*][size=3]NPCs can ask for permission to enter[/size]
[/list][size=3]
[u][b]Español[/b][/u][b][u]:[/u][/b]
[/size][list]
[*][size=3][size=3]Compatible con casas mod / npcs mod[/size][/size]
[*][size=3][size=3]Más corazones = mas probable que visite[/size][/size]
[*][size=3][size=3]Lista negra[/size][/size]
[*][size=3][size=3]Horas de inicio/termino custom[/size][/size]
[*][size=3][size=3][size=3]Probabilidad custom (por cada 10 min.)[/size][/size][/size]
[*][size=3][size=3][size=3]Funciona en multijugador[/size][/size][/size]
[*][size=3][size=3][size=3]Los regalos (de visita) son opcionales[/size][/size][/size]
[*][size=3][size=3][size=3]Los PNJs pueden pedir permiso para entrar[/size][/size][/size]
[/list]

[img]https://64.media.tumblr.com/f95133a89c36c50f18ca98e9183f9a82/ce5c30fe86a2d83a-34/s500x750/f71edb63ddb02d6deb5a1845272162d4ce609647.png[/img]﻿
[u][b][size=3]English:[/size][/b][/u][size=3]
[color=#ff0000][b]NOTICE:[/b][/color] Schedules are loaded every in-game day, please don't use CP's "Update"[size=3][size=3] field.[/size][/size]
You can add custom visits via ContentPatcher, like this:

[/size][size=3][b][u][size=3][u][b]Español[/b][/u][/size]:[/u][/b]
[b][color=#ff0000]AVISO:[/color][/b] Las rutinas se cargan cada día, si usas "Update" no se registrará.
Puedes agregar visitas custom usando [/size][size=3]ContentPatcher, así:
[code]{
"Action": "EditData",
"Target": "mistyspring.farmhousevisits/Schedules",
"Entries": {
"George": {
"From": 700,
"To": 1000,
"EntryDialogue": "Hi, @. What are you young kids getting up to?",
"ExitDialogue": "It's getting cold...#$b# I have to go. Goodbye, @.",
"Dialogues": [
"This house isn't so bad...",
"%George is looking at you as you work."
]
}
}
}[/code]

[img]https://64.media.tumblr.com/09a1e108e3315a12ea464e7c1a10cc95/ce5c30fe86a2d83a-0d/s400x600/f6ed1545f0565408e462d2636028a08ff845ff28.png[/img]
